description.value: Caspian Flame is a Turkish restaurant on West Broadway in Vancouver, serving döner wraps, börek, and Mediterranean staples. The chicken döner is slow-roasted on a vertical rotisserie and served in warm lavash — a satisfying, high-calorie option for cyclists. It offers both dine-in and online ordering with pickup and delivery.
